# John W. Creswell

> > Official website of John W. Creswell, internationally recognized authority on mixed methods research, qualitative research methodology, and author of foundational research design textbooks.

Dr. Creswell is a distinguished academic researcher and author affiliated with the University of Michigan, University of Nebraska, and founding co-editor of the Journal of Mixed Methods Research. His work spans research methodology education, consulting, and personal memoir writing including 'Uncovering Grief.'

## Key Topics

- Mixed methods research
- Qualitative research
- Research methodology
- Research design
- SAGE Publications
- Journal of Mixed Methods Research
- Mixed Methods International Research Association
- University of Michigan
- University of Nebraska
- Michigan Mixed Methods Program
- Workshops and training
- Academic consulting
- Family medicine research
- Clinical psychology
